title: Removing Minimum Number of Magic Beans
goal: Remove the fewest beans so every nonempty bag has the same count.
strategy: For a chosen positive target, bags smaller than it must be emptied and larger bags reduced. Sort counts; choosing the target at index i keeps target times the number of bags from i onward.
